For this set, the key Korean future construction is:

verb stem + -(으)ㄹ 거예요

가다 → 갈 거예요
먹다 → 먹을 거예요
만들다 → 만들 거예요
있다 → 있을 거예요
없다 → 없을 거예요

It covers a lot of what English expresses with both will and going to. Context and the speaker's intention/prediction determine the precise interpretation.
native_answer: Coach isn't going to make us lift weights.
